description: Reproducibility run — Stage 1 ensemble (v21_fast_advanced) on real Kaggle data

dataset.notes: 159K customers, ~400M transactions across batch_0 through batch_87

notes: Held-out fold AUC (0.9203) is lower than the competition leaderboard public score (0.9773). The gap is most likely a training-fold vs held-out difference — the 0.9773 figure in the README is from the original competition submission and may reflect a training-set AUC rather than held-out. The hypothesis is unconfirmed: rerunning with both train-fold and val-fold AUC logged would resolve it.
No calibration or probability rescaling was applied in this run; probabilities are raw ensemble outputs.

Per-model AUCs here (0.9118 / 0.8994 / 0.9185 / 0.9110) differ from earlier figures in the README (0.9061 / 0.8993 / 0.9080 / 0.9112), which came from an undocumented earlier run. These are the verifiable numbers.
code_provenance: v3/generate_submission_v21_fast_advanced.py — per-model AUC logging and structured JSON output
